name: @mercatus-liber/webhooks
description: Outbound webhook delivery for the event bus (epic outbound-webhook-event-delivery). @mercatus-liber/core's EventBus (packages/core/src/event-bus.ts) is purely in-process -- there was zero mechanism for an external consumer (Zapier/Make/n8n, a merchant's own backend) to register a URL and receive a real HTTP POST when a subsystem publishes an event. This package extends the bus, it doesn't replace it: a WebhookDeliveryService subscribes to a known set of real event names on an injected EventBus and fans each matching publish out to every active WebhookSubscription registered for that event type, as a real HTTP POST with an HMAC-SHA256 signature (mirroring adapter-printify's verifyPrintifySignature's exact `sha256={hex}`-over-the-raw-body convention, applied outbound) in the `x-mercatus-liber-signature` header, real bounded retry/backoff on delivery failure, and a durable delivery log. Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only (EventBus, referenced structurally). A durable (Postgres) WebhookSubscriptionStore/WebhookDeliveryLogStore pair lives in @mercatus-liber/adapter-postgres (webhooks.ts), same split as every other subsystem's in-memory-default/Postgres-second-adapter pattern.
